file.header: These variables may be changed anytime during a run, they control jobs that are dependent on case.run.

entry.desc: Location of CUPiD for CESM workflow
Location of CUPiD output written by CESM workflow
When TRUE, CUPiD will generate time series files from history output
When TRUE, CUPiD will regrid the time series files (requires CUPID_GEN_TIMESERIES=TRUE)
When TRUE, CUPiD will generate diagnostic plots
When TRUE, CUPiD will generate web pages from the diagnostic plots
When TRUE, CUPiD will run the CESM-specific Climate Model Output Rewriter (CMOR) tools
File to use to remap atmosphere time series files from case (NONE => do not remap)
File to use to remap atmosphere time series files from baseline case (NONE => do not remap)
Conda environment to use when running CUPiD notebooks
Conda environment to use when running CUPiD tools
First year of output to include in CUPiD analysis. Format YYYY-MM-DD.
Sets the portion of output to include in CUPiD analysis, along with STOP_N.
Provides a numerical count for $CUPID_STOP_OPTION.
Year to end climatology, eg for LDF
Number of years to use for climatology, eg for LDF
Number of years offset time axis when plotting global timeseries of CESM case
Number of years to include per time series file when running GenTS
Label to use in plot legends to describe case
Number of years to include per time series file when running GenTS for comparison cases. Can be single value for all cases or comma-separated list.
Timeseries directory for baseline case to use in generating ts. Change this in the case of directory permission issues to eg, your scratch directory
Example to use in CUPiD analysis
Type of CTSM run: either 'BGC' (biogeochemistry) or 'SP' (satellite phenology)
First date of output to include in each CUPiD comparison list. Format YYYY-MM-DD (or comma-separated list).
Provides a numerical count for comparison cases in units of $CUPID_STOP_OPTION. Can be single value or comma-separated list.
Year to end comparison case climatologies, eg for LDF. Can be single value for all cases or comma-separated list.
Number of years offset time axis when plotting global timeseries of comparison case(s)
Number of years to use for comparison case climatologies, eg for LDF. Can be single value for all cases or comma-separated list.
Comma-separated list of cases to compare to current CESM case
Root of all cases being compared. Can be a single string if common across cases, otherwise comma-separated list of same length as CUPID_COMPARISON_CASES
Label to use in plot legends to describe baseline case. Can be single value or comma-separated list.
Boolean value that determines whether or not diagnostics for all components are run
Boolean value that determines whether or not ATM diagnostics are run (if CUPID_RUN_ALL is FALSE)
Boolean value that determines whether or not OCN diagnostics are run (if CUPID_RUN_ALL is FALSE)
Boolean value that determines whether or not LND diagnostics are run (if CUPID_RUN_ALL is FALSE)
Boolean value that determines whether or not ICE diagnostics are run (if CUPID_RUN_ALL is FALSE)
Boolean value that determines whether or not ROF diagnostics are run (if CUPID_RUN_ALL is FALSE)
Boolean value that determines whether or not GLC diagnostics are run (if CUPID_RUN_ALL is FALSE)
Boolean value that determines whether or not ADF diagnostics are run
Boolean value that determines whether or not CVDP diagnostics are run (requires CUPID_RUN_ADF=TRUE)
Boolean value that determines whether or not LDF diagnostics are run
Boolean value that determines whether or not ILAMB diagnostics are run
